general.notes: Source document is a FortiGate 3600E series NGFW appliance datasheet, not a dedicated optical transceiver module datasheet. Electrical power (672 W average / 977 W maximum) and operating temperature (0–40°C) apply to the FortiGate chassis. Transceiver-related strings (form factors, bit rates, LC on CWDM4, 2 KM, 4 channel parallel fiber) appear only in optional accessory ordering rows and included 2x SFP+ (SR 10 GE); no optical power, OSNR, sensitivity, wavelength nm, FEC, or penalty tables are stated for any transceiver SKU.
general.suggestions: Run extraction on an individual transceiver module datasheet (e.g. FN-TRAN-QSFP28-SR) rather than a host platform datasheet; optionally distinguish host platform fields from pluggable module fields in the schema.
